tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// tshe sgrub zab mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ tshe sgrub zab mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ snga dro gnyid sad ma thag sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum brjod/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang du padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu padma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar du kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lhor yon tan tshe dpag med/ lho nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ thams cad kyang sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing mtshan dpes mdzes pa/ rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod/ de nas tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sku re re la dmigs nas/ gzungs ring tshar re re ste dgu ngag bcad nas bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zab mo stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba snying thag pa nas btab pas/ snying dbus kyi tshe dpag med lha dgus dbu gug gug lan gsum mdzad nas dngos grub stsal bar bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces smon lam btab cing 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob snyam pa the tshom med pa byas na/ 'chi ba slu nges pa'i mchog yin te/ slob dpon dze tā ri'i thugs kyi yang snying*/ sa skya pa'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/

grub rgyal gling pa pad rgyal gyi thugs dam du sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis sbyin pa yin pas nyams len chag med gal che/ 'di nyams su len pa rnams kyis tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gis rgyud smin par byas nas/ man ngag 'di'i lung rgyun ldan gyi bla ma las blangs te brtson par bya'o// ༈ /tshe sgrub kyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'debs 'chi med mchog ster ces bya ba bzhugs so// 'chi med mgon po slob dpon snying po'i zhabs// dze tā ri pa rdo rje gdan pa gnyis// ba ri lo tsā rje btsun brtse ba che// bsod nams rtse mo rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grags pa rgyal mtshan sa paṇa rdo rje 'od// 'khon ston shar pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i mtshan// spang khang pa dang sru lung brag phug pa// ri khrod grub chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal tshul shar chen ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// dpal ldan rdo rje sa skya lo tsā ba// kun dga' rin chen bsod nams dbang po dang*// kun dga' bsod nams rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang*// bsod nams rin chen kun dga' blo gros zhabs// byams pa bstan 'dzin nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skyabs su 'gro dang byang chub sems bskyed nas// snying dbus pad zlar bcom ldan tshe dpag med// 'khor bcas mngon gsum bzhin du gsal btab pas// lhar snang sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin 'grub par shog /gzung sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod dri bzhon gyis// 'chi med dbang po'i thugs rje'i sprin dkar po// rtse gcig bskul las mkhyen brtse'i bdud rtsi yis// tshe dang ye shes padmo rgyas gyur cig /mdor na gnas skabs dus min 'chi ba sogs// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen phun tshogs shing*// mthar thug 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog

/ces pa'ang rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin nos pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
